key_insight: Finite-rate thermodynamic relaxation transforms the flash-evaporation expansion shock toward a self-similar rarefaction wave as relaxation time increases.
engineering_relevance: The method supports more reliable simulation of rapid flashing flows by suppressing spurious pressure oscillations while retaining physical phase-change pressure dynamics.
method: Derive mechanical-equilibrium evolution equations for a thermodynamic relaxation system.
Develop a Homogeneous Relaxation Real Fluid finite-volume method coupling Euler equations with mass relaxation.
Advect internal energy–pressure affine parameters and vapor volume fraction to maintain pressure consistency.
evidence_signal: Flash-evaporation Riemann-problem evaluations show that longer mass-transfer relaxation times smooth expansion and lower intermediate pressure and velocity, while heat-transfer relaxation controls phase temperature differences.
watch_item: The abstract reports Riemann-problem evaluations but does not establish experimental validation or robustness for multidimensional engineering flows.
paper_title: Flash evaporation Riemann Problem: Thermodynamic Relaxation and Oscillation-Free Real Fluid Finite Volume Method
